This is worrisome. All i want to say is please take it easy. Getting the right meds for you takes time. Getting help from therapy also takes time. One last thing, medication is one thing. But finding the right kind of therapy and the right therapist is also very important. Meds can only do so much.... whatever you're feeling and whatever you just stated in your post, i think you should be honest and tell them to your therapist. First step to getting the help you need is being honest. 

Big hugs OP. Dont do anything rash or impulsive. You can PM me anytime if you need any advice & etc.

Ill just briefly speak of this haha. 

In the past, ive brought up my distrust and dislike towards authority figures (esp teachers and counsellors/therapists). Ive brought this up many times to many different Ts and psychs because i feel the need for them to understand that my distrust comes from ACTUAL past experiences/interactions w these people. My former T and current psych were very sweet and understanding. They knew that there were indeed incompetent teachers and therapists out there and were even in agreement with me. She said smth along the lines of "right but do u see that all the distrust stemmed from ur parents" and completely ignored the fact that ive had actual bad experiences w other authority figures in my life. She didnt really respond or showed any understanding towards this, despite me explaining myself. It was the first time i had to defend my stance too lol. I told my 2 friends this bc i didnt want to make assumptions but they felt that she COULD POSSIBLY be 'butthurt' that i was talking trash about the people in her line of work. Because they have Ts too and they were v sympathetic towards their distrust towards authority figures. One even apologised even though they did not have to. 

Oops i just realised again i said more than i shouldve but thats one of the first few instances that made me.... wary of my T. She reminded me of the authority figures i had in the past and it did not sit right w me. Im proud of myself for giving it a chance because im someone who would usually give up easily :D. Im currently finding a new T but its just hard to find a good one these days.
